# pantechdynamics_access_policy (Data Source)

Looks up one access policy by id or name: one of your organization's, or a Pantech-managed one such as pol_pantech_developer or pol_pantech_read_only, for example to attach it with pantechdynamics_access_policy_attachment or to reuse its statements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a policy up by id or name, including Pantech's managed ones.
data "pantechdynamics_access_policy" "read_only" {
  id = "pol_pantech_read_only"
}

output "read_only_statements" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_access_policy.read_only.policy_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the policy, such as pol_01JD... or pol_pantech_developer. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the policy. It must match exactly; names are unique. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_count` (Number) How many members and teams the policy is attached to.
- `description` (String) The policy's description.
- `managed` (Boolean) True for a Pantech-managed policy, which cannot change.
- `policy_json` (String) The statements as policy JSON, in a normal form, usable as another policy's policy_json.
- `statements` (Attributes List) The policy's statements, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statements))
- `version` (Number) Version of the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--statements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statements`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (Set of String) 1 to 50 actions, such as "instances:Stop", or wildcards in the service or the verb: "instances:*", "*:Read", "*". The pantechdynamics_iam_actions data source lists every action.
- `conditions` (Attributes) Conditions that must all hold for the statement to apply. Leave it out for none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statements--conditions))
- `effect` (String) "allow" or "deny". A matching deny always wins, for admins and members alike; owners are never limited by a policy.
- `resources` (Set of String) 1 to 50 resources: "*", a resource id such as "vm_01JD...", or "name:<pattern>" matched against the resource's name ("*" any run of characters, "?" one character, case-insensitive), such as "name:staging-*".
- `sid` (String) An optional label for the statement, unique within the policy: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '_' or '-'.

<a id="nestedatt--statements--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statements.conditions`

Read-Only:

- `mfa` (Boolean) true: the statement applies only to a session signed in with MFA, never to an API key. false on a deny: the deny applies only without MFA ("nothing without MFA"). false on an allow is the same as leaving it out.
- `source_ip` (Set of String) The request must come from one of these 1 to 20 IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR blocks (a single address is its /32 or /128).
